_missingReason: Every pool file now has a title, so `_missing` is empty; this key is kept only to record why it was ever non-empty and to retract a claim made here while it was. The former twelve gaps came from two rips whose filenames are bare numbers (NN.flac), which carry no title. The text in this place used to assert that the numeric suffix of tem_NN / spa_NN IS the published track number on the source album. The two were the SAME recording, measured on this machine by lag-searching cross-correlation on the pool .dsp files themselves: every excerpt of the short file matches at lag ~0 AND at lag ~293.28 s with near-identical ncc (0.9495 / 0.9494), and the long file self-correlates at ncc 0.9955 with a seam click at 293.257 s -- i.e. the long file is pass + pass + a 10.06 s closing reprise of the opening. An earlier window study on the FLAC sources agreed: every 5 s window of the 293 s TxK file matches Space_Giraffe/01.flac at ncc 0.964-0.997 (median 0.989) at a single lag drifting 218 -> 269 samples across 293 s, the signature of one master resampled to two rates (31999 Hz gamerip vs 48000 Hz TxK rip), not of two recordings. _unverified.note: RENDERING FIX, NOT A RENAME, applied 2026-10-12 -- the composition is still the published Tempest 2000 track 'Mind's Eye' and the pool stems 01_mindseye are untouched. What changed is the apostrophe CODEPOINT: both files carried U+2019 RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK (e2 80 99) and now carry ASCII U+0027. THE CAUSE IS THE FONT, and the font is t2k_core/src/rendering/font_data.cpp, a 51-glyph procedural vector font whose entire coverage surface is charToIndex(), which takes ONE BYTE and ends in `return -1; // Space or unknown`. Both writeAfont() implementations (t2k_3ds/src/rendering/text_c3d.cpp and t2k_pc/src/rendering/vk_font.cpp) then run `if (fi < 0 || fi >= FONT_CHAR_COUNT) continue;` followed by `const float hOff = charWidth * ci;` -- the advance is taken from the BYTE INDEX ci and not from a count of drawn glyphs, so an unmapped byte moves the pen a full character cell and draws NOTHING. U+2019 is three bytes and all three fall outside every range charToIndex() knows (0xE2=226, 0x80=128, 0x99=153), so the string drew 'Mind' + three blank cells + 's Eye'.
